newsitem.title: USA: Donaldson Q1 backlogs rise 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Donaldson Q1 backlogs rise 11 pct.

text.p: Donaldson Co Inc, a manufacturer of filtration systems, said its backlog of $219.9 million at the end of the October 31 first quarter was 11 percent higher than the same year-ago period.

Backlogs increased for both the engine products and industrial products segments. It said gas turbine backlogs rose 40 percent from the end of the previous quarter, reenforcing the outlook for strong sales in the balance of this year.

For the quarter, Donaldson posted earnings of $0.45 per share, up from $0.39 a year ago. Sales were $187.2 million compared with $188.9 million. Excluding Donaldson's gas turbine business unit, which experiences significant revenue fluctuations from quarter to quarter, net sales were up about eight percent from the first quarter of last year, the company said.

"Sales growth continues to meet or exceed expectations," said chairman William Van Dyke in a statement. He expected gas turbine revenues to accelerate in the next three quarters, "with full-year sales at or slightly above last year's level."
